verdict.rationale: Floot documents exporting both code and database for self-hosting elsewhere, directly supporting data portability and leaving the platform, but there's no evidence of a broader open-format export (e.g., structured data exports, account data, media assets) beyond code/DB, nor independent confirmation the export is complete or in fully open standard formats. missing for 10: evidence of full data export scope (assets, user data, configs), independent/hands-on verification of export completeness, and confirmation of open standard formats used.
